identificationModule.briefTitle: Clinical Study of Irinotecan Liposome (II)-Based Combination Treatment for Irinotecan-resistant Colorectal Cancer.
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Single-center Phase II Clinical Study of Irinotecan Liposome (II)-Based Combination Regimen as a Treatment for Irinotecan-Resistant Colorectal Cancer.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Phase II clinical study of irinotecan liposome (II)-based combination regimen as a treatment for irinotecan-resistant colorectal cancer.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: To observe and evaluate the efficacy and safety of irinotecan liposome (II)-based combination regimen as a treatment for irinotecan-resistant colorectal cancer.

armGroups.label: Irinotecan Liposomes (II)+Cetuximab+Bevacizumabl
armGroups.description: Irinotecan Liposomes (II)，Cetuximab and Bevacizumabl injection was started on Day 1 of each cycle.Combined treatment for 2 weeks, after efficacy evaluation, the investigator decides the subsequent treatment regimen, or until disease progression, toxicity intolerance, initiation of new anti-tumor therapy, withdrawal of informed consent, or the investigator judges that the subject needs to withdraw from the study treatment. Following RECISTv1.1 defined progression (as assessed by the investigator), study drug may continue if the investigator assesses that the subject is still receiving clinical benefit and tolerates study treatment.

interventions.name: Irinotecan Liposomes (II)+Cetuximab+Bevacizumabl
interventions.description:
Irinotecan Liposomes (II) injection：Intravenous infusion, 60 mg/m2, Day 1, Q2W. The recommended initial dosage of irinotecan liposomes (II) for patients with the UGT1A1 \* 28/\* 6 homozygous mutation is 47.1 mg/m2.

Cetuximab injection：Intravenous infusion, 500 mg/m2, Day 1, Q2W. Bevacizumabl: Intravenous infusion, 5mg/kg, Day 1, Q2W.

primaryOutcomes.description: The time from randomization to the first documented progressive disease (PD) or death due to any cause, whichever occurred first

secondaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of patients with a confirmed complete response or partial response
The proportion of patients with a best overall response of confirmed complete or partial response, or stable disease
The time from randomization to death from any reason
The length of time that a tumor continues to respond to treatment without the cancer growing or spreading.
The dose suspension rate and dose termination rate caused by adverse events were determined according to NCI-CTCAE V5.0 standard
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Safety visits were made before medication in each treatment cycle day1
